corrections.text: The headline says Vinext runs Next.js apps "on Any Platform". That is Cloudflare's own claim (its blog says Vinext can make an app "portable to be deployed to any web platform, including the Cloudflare Workers free plan, Netlify, or AWS Lambda"), not an independently verified result. The blog describes its test suite as covering "the deployment targets of Nodejs and Cloudflare Workers" and says Vinext has "limited support" for the "use cache" directive behind Cache Components.
